leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply CSS Modules to create scoped styles that prevent naming conflicts in React components.
Implement CSS Modules by importing style objects from .module.css files into TypeScript components.
Use TypeScript interfaces to define type-safe props for components that receive CSS class names.
Assign CSS class names to JSX elements by accessing properties from the imported style object.
Construct CSS Modules files with standard CSS syntax to define component-specific styles.
Utilize CSS Modules to apply multiple class names to a single element using template literals or array joins.
Execute conditional class name application based on component state or props using CSS Modules.
Define and use CSS custom properties (variables) within CSS Modules for consistent theming.
Access nested CSS selectors within CSS Modules to style child elements without global conflicts.
Modify existing React components to replace global CSS with scoped CSS Modules implementation.
Control CSS specificity by leveraging the automatic scoping provided by CSS Modules.
Implement responsive design patterns within CSS Modules using media queries and scoped selectors.
